title: "The Chase" Becomes a Treasure Hunt Around Europe
summary:
A popular British quiz show is going on a trip. ITV Studios has announced a new show called "The Chase Around the World," Variety reports. It is one of 10 new show ideas the company will share at Mipcom, a big TV market.

In the show, six pairs of players try to find The Chasers. The Chasers are six quiz experts. They will hide in secret places across Europe. The teams solve puzzles along the way. The winning pair then faces The Chasers in a quiz for a big prize.

There are other new shows, too. In "Expedition Into the Wild," eight city celebrities spend 18 days in a wild place and must build shelters. In "Celebrity Escape," seven comedians solve puzzles in escape rooms.

Nature fans can look for "Secret Garden," narrated by David Attenborough. It shows animals living in gardens.
why_it_matters: It shows how TV makers turn puzzles and quizzes into adventures families can enjoy.
